notes: Provisional, recalibrated by CS-E-02.F11 (build-log/reports/rca-gate1-weak-band.md) on the live corpus, because the corpus changed after cal-2026-11-27-03 (D-070 article edits in 71d3254 and 64bb70f, after the baseline run at 58e9693; old corpus_version f0f1a441..., so every search on main reported calibration_stale true). Method unchanged (doc 07 s4.1 steps 1 to 3, D-052, D-053): the same 30 probes (18 answerable, 6 off_topic, 6 not_in_docs) through the real search code with calibration=true, k=5, top cosine among the returned chunks, script services/knowledge/scripts/probe_retrieval.py, one embedding request, run_at 2026-11-28T02:14:17.167453+00:00. tau_low and tau_high are computed over the 20 GENERIC probes only; scenario probes are checks with margins (under 0.02 flagged RISK). Gate 1 input (CS-E-02.F11): Gate 1 now scores each returned chunk by the higher of the model query's cosine and the customer message's cosine. A probe is a customer question sent as the query, so these numbers are the customer-message score the gate now always includes; a model query can only raise a chunk's score, never lower it.
